Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 60

“For the turbulent senses, Kaunteya, forcibly carry away the mind even of a discerning person who is striving.”

Krishna warns the sincere, not the careless. The person in this verse is both wise and trying hard, and is still overpowered — a candid admission placed just before he offers the remedy.
